attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Aear Corek: 30-year-old woman, 166 cm (medium), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: heart-shaped face; close-set eyes and a high arched brow; prominent bridge, compact mouth; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, medium-loose, deliberate accent: wrapped side section. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: an extensive matte botanical tattoo language over one shoulder, torso edge, and forearm; one asymmetric ear cuff; a shallow cheek scar. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection shows exactly one adult woman with one coherent body and no duplicated anatomy.
The complete loose wrapped hair, head, both hands, clay tea token, both fitted shoes, quilted outerwear, and trouser cuffs remain inside generous margins.

Visible brush planes and controlled illustrative texture across skin, hair, quilted cloth, tattoos, and parchment staging read as cinematic semi-realistic painting rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

The medium sturdy-stocky broad body, medium-deep skin, heart-shaped face, close-set eyes, arched brow, blonde-gold hair, teal-brown quilted outerwear, toggles, tapered trousers, knee folds, extensive botanical shoulder/torso/forearm tattoo, asymmetric ear cuff, cheek scar, and clay token are legible. However, extra forehead and facial marks extend beyond the declared cheek scar and tattoo scope, and waist tools plus dangling charms exceed the three-detail contract.
The compact mouth is closed and unsmiling; eyes and high brow remain composed without theatrical acting.

The figure remains an ordinary grounded mortal in quilted cloth with a clay token and no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, affinity cue, glow, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

The stocky build, blonde color, face, and quilted outfit are distinct, but the long wrapped braid with multiple gold bands draped over one shoulder reproduces the reference’s dominant braid silhouette and ornament construction too closely for the strict non-transfer gate.

attempts.retryReason: Strict inspection rejected manifest fidelity and original identity. The orchestrator authorized exactly one call and no correction, so no corrective attempt was made.
